cornell-potential-confinement-model-0efb.title: Cornell Potential (Confinement)

cornell-potential-confinement-model-0efb.limits_and_boundary: As $r \to \infty$, the linear term $\sigma r$ ensures that the energy required for separation diverges, preventing isolation.

analytical-mechanics-stationary-action-b.title: Hamilton's Principle of Stationary Action
analytical-mechanics-stationary-action-b.interpretation: Defines the fundamental variational principle stating that the actual path traversed by a physical system is the one for which the action integral is stationary (extremized) under infinitesimal coordinate perturbations with fixed endpoints.
analytical-mechanics-stationary-action-b.symmetry_origin: Originates from the topological properties of paths in configuration space and the conservation of energy and momentum under coordinate-invariance.
analytical-mechanics-stationary-action-b.limits_and_boundary: Reduces to Newtonian particle paths under highly localized potentials and flat metric spaces, and maps to the classical limit of the quantum propagator path integral as \( \hbar \to 0 \).
